unresolved: n_seeds=1 reflects the paper's explicit statement of using a single random train/test split (not a model-training seed count); no repeated-trial or multi-seed protocol is used anywhere in the experiments.

n_models=2 counts the two target classifiers evaluated (DREBIN linear SVM, Sec-SVM hardened variant); Table I's cross-domain comparison of prior attacks (images, audio, text, PDF, Windows, etc.) is related-work description via the paper's formalization, not this paper's own experiments, so those rows were excluded.

n_baselines=0 because no other attack method is empirically run for comparison in the experiments section; Rosenberg et al. and Yang et al. are discussed only qualitatively (Table I formalization and Related Work prose), not re-implemented or benchmarked on the same dataset.

reports_variability='figure' reflects population-level distributions across test malware (Fig. 3 feature-count CDF, Fig. 4 app-statistics CDF, Fig. 5 violin plot of injection times), not run-to-run/seed variability, since only one split was used.
